notes:
v1.4.0 Release:
- New: All Tabs > Make names consistent. Gives each character and place the same Khmer name in every part of a movie, and saves the names to the Character Glossary
- The Character Glossary is used again by Transcribe, Fix Missing and Translate in the main editor, so later parts keep the same names
- One All Tabs menu: Transcribe all tabs now runs several parts at once, with live progress and a Stop button
- Smarter API key switching: when a key hits Google's limit, work moves to the least busy free key
- Safer connection to Gemini: secure certificate checks are back on, and API keys are no longer sent inside web addresses
- Fixed voice playing too fast, faster performance, and other bug fixes
